# Character scope (portrait modifiers at priority = 106, selection_behavior = max).
# Self-contained pure declarative triggers using ONLY vanilla tags, culture_groups, graphical cultures,
# government_types, and closed era intervals so Main Mod passes strict standalone audits and NEVER
# overrides v61's 1204-1336 Mongol royal indigo deel or 1337 vanilla/D008 Byzantine attire.

oe_v66_3d_eligible_male_court = {
	exists = this
	is_adult = yes
	is_female = no
	is_religious_figure = no
	NOT = { has_estate = estate_type:clergy_estate }
	NOT = { portrait_clergy_trigger = { RELIGION_GFX = buddhist_gfx } }
	NOT = { is_general = yes }
	NOT = { is_mercenary_leader = yes }
	NOT = { any_ruling_countries = { government_type = government_type:theocracy } }
	NOT = { any_ruling_countries = { has_reform = government_reform:military_order_reform } }
	NOT = { any_ruling_countries = { country_type = army } }
	NOT = { any_ruling_countries = { government_type = government_type:steppe_horde } }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_v49_portraits_vanilla_mode }
}

# 1. Late Antique Roman/Byzantine/Sassanian Imperial Tyrian-Purple & Gold Chlamys (361-768)
#    Strictly bounded to 361-768 so 1337+ vanilla/D008 Byzantine regalia is untouched.
oe_v66_3d_late_antique_imperial = {
	oe_v66_3d_eligible_male_court = yes
	current_year >= 361
	current_year <= 768
	is_ruler = yes
	NOT = { portrait_religion_clothing_trigger = { RELIGION_FLAG = muslim_gfx } }
	NOT = { gfx_culture_applicable = mongol_gfx }
	NOT = { culture ?= { has_culture_group = culture_group:mongolian_group } }
	any_ruling_countries = {
		country_rank_level >= 3
		government_type = government_type:monarchy
	}
	OR = {
		any_ruling_countries = {
			OR = {
				tag = BYZ
				tag = ROM
				tag = PER
				has_or_had_tag = BYZ
				has_or_had_tag = ROM
				has_or_had_tag = PER
			}
		}
		culture ?= { has_culture_group = culture_group:iranian_group }
		culture ?= { has_culture_group = culture_group:greek_group }
		culture ?= { has_culture_group = culture_group:italian_group }
	}
}

# 2. Tang/Song Imperial Vermilion-Saffron Dragon Brocade (632-1279 Chinese & Sinosphere monarchs)
#    Strictly excludes Mongol, Steppe Horde, Jurchen/Manchu, and Japanese courts so v61 Mongol deel
#    and v49 Jurchen/Japanese attire are never overridden.
oe_v66_3d_tang_song_monarch = {
	oe_v66_3d_eligible_male_court = yes
	current_year >= 632
	current_year <= 1279
	is_ruler = yes
	NOT = { gfx_culture_applicable = mongol_gfx }
	NOT = { gfx_culture_applicable = mongolian_coa_gfx }
	NOT = { gfx_culture_applicable = tungusic_coa_gfx }
	NOT = { gfx_culture_applicable = japanese_gfx }
	NOT = { culture ?= { has_culture_group = culture_group:mongolian_group } }
	NOT = { culture ?= { has_culture_group = culture_group:jurchen_group } }
	NOT = { culture ?= { has_culture_group = culture_group:tungusic_group } }
	NOT = { culture ?= { has_culture_group = culture_group:japanese_group } }
	any_ruling_countries = {
		country_rank_level >= 3
		government_type = government_type:monarchy
	}
	OR = {
		culture ?= { has_culture_group = culture_group:chinese_group }
		culture ?= { has_culture_group = culture_group:confucian_group }
		any_ruling_countries = {
			OR = {
				tag = CSH
				tag = CSO
				tag = KOR
				tag = DAI
			}
		}
	}
}

# 3. Napoleonic / 1821 High-Collar Imperial Uniform Coat (1776-1836 European/American monarchs & generals)
#    Preserves east_mediterranean_gfx/roman_gfx (Byzantine D008), Islamic, Mongol, Jurchen, and East Asian courts.
oe_v66_3d_napoleonic_imperial = {
	oe_v66_3d_eligible_male_any_role = yes
	current_year >= 1776
	current_year <= 1836
	gfx_culture_applicable = european_gfx
	NOT = { gfx_culture_applicable = east_mediterranean_gfx }
	NOT = { gfx_culture_applicable = roman_gfx }
	NOT = { portrait_religion_clothing_trigger = { RELIGION_FLAG = muslim_gfx } }
	NOT = { gfx_culture_applicable = mongol_gfx }
	NOT = { culture ?= { has_culture_group = culture_group:mongolian_group } }
	NOT = { culture ?= { has_culture_group = culture_group:jurchen_group } }
	NOT = { culture ?= { has_culture_group = culture_group:tungusic_group } }
	NOT = { culture ?= { has_culture_group = culture_group:chinese_group } }
	NOT = { culture ?= { has_culture_group = culture_group:japanese_group } }
	OR = {
		is_ruler = yes
		is_general = yes
	}
}
